name: Recollection of Days Past
description:
After your character receives healing from a source other than an Artifact: This card gains 1 stack of Yearning (max 4). At the start of the round, for every 2 stacks of Yearning, heal the attached character for 1 HP.
(A character can equip a maximum of 1 Artifact)

storytitle: Unswerving Vow: Recollection of Days Past
storytext: "No matter what price I must pay, I will save you from those freezing fetters, your eternal chains. And when we finally enjoy the embrace of the Queen of All Waters once more, we shall take leave of trouble and sorrow."
